intro: This errand marks the opening step in unraveling the covert syndicate terrorizing Westfall. Dispatched by Gryan Stoutmantle of Sentinel Hill, travelers are directed eastward into Redridge to consult a shady contact who might know where the thieves hide.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood. I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs. We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out. In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.
Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, Stoutmantle sent you? Well, I owe him.
